bullets.text: Copilot Settings Rollout - **Microsoft** begins rolling out direct settings access for **Copilot** on Windows Insiders.
AI Enthusiasts Rise - Users leveraging AI report increased ambition and confidence, according to **Microsoft**'s latest consumer AI report.
Security Culture at Microsoft - **Microsoft** emphasizes a proactive security culture through revamped training and the Secure Future Initiative.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New features and improvements announced for **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 26220.6780.
AI-Ready Infrastructure Expansion - **Microsoft** is expanding its cloud infrastructure across Asia to meet growing demand.
Microsoft Ignite 2025 - **Microsoft** Ignite will focus on security advancements, featuring hands-on sessions and expert insights.
Disrupting Teams Threats - **Microsoft** provides guidance on securing **Teams** against cyber threats in a new blog post.
AI Toolkit for VS Code - **Microsoft** introduces an AI Toolkit for **Visual Studio Code** to simplify generative AI app development.
